notes: Identify the primary user, target user job, success signal, and non goals.
Trace acceptance criteria to a real user journey and an end to end journey.
Exercise failure and recovery for invitations, concurrent edits, offline entry, and settlement.
Run a security and privacy review for household membership and financial data.
Add observability with monitoring and alerts for entry and settlement failures.
Use staged rollout and rollback with an executable rollback plan.
Report residual risk and all remaining risks before the go or no-go decision.
